You only need the first three terms to start. The others appear when you add
checks, storage or reporting.

| Term | Meaning | First use |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Reusable instructions for a named table | [Lesson 1](first-product.html) |
| Result | The outcome and evidence from one execution | [Lesson 1](first-product.html) |
| Collect | Obtain an ordinary table from a successful result | [Lesson 1](first-product.html) |
| Contract | Required columns, types, keys and other table promises | [Lesson 2](check-delivery.html) |
| Quality rule | A test of whether the values are acceptable | [Lesson 2](check-delivery.html) |
| Target | The destination to which checked output is written | [Lesson 3](publish-data.html) |
| Lake | A configured store with release history | [Lesson 3](publish-data.html) |
| Release | One saved, immutable version of a table in a lake | [Lesson 3](publish-data.html) |
| Pinned input | An exact release, rather than whichever data is current | [Lesson 4](save-report.html) |
| Metric | A named calculation with defined input and time meaning | [Lesson 4](save-report.html) |
| Issued report | Saved values and evidence that are read without recalculating | [Lesson 4](save-report.html) |
| Partition | Rows sharing a field such as reporting date, replaced as a whole | [Lesson 5](getting-started.html) |
| Stock / flow | A value at one date / an amount over a period | [Lesson 5](getting-started.html) |
| Layer | A named storage area, such as raw or core | [DuckLake](create-ducklake.html) |
| Receipt | The received input retained before downstream preparation | [Layered workflow](layered-data-stack.html) |
| Lineage | Recorded relationships between inputs and outputs | [Quality and history](quality-history.html) |
| Adapter | A component connecting the workflow to a specific tool | [Integrations](optional-integrations.html) |

## Three execution verbs

| Call | Use it when | Writes? |
|---|---|---|
| `trial(product)` | You want to try preparation and checks | Disables configured framework targets and catalogs |
| `publish(product)` | You intend to save checked output | Yes, to the selected destination |
| `run(definition)` | You want to execute its full configuration | May write, depending on the configuration |

Trial mode cannot sandbox side effects inside your own callbacks. Keep source
and transformation functions free of unintended writes.

`publish()` does not upload to a public website. `report_release()` does not
render a document. A lake may use ordinary DuckDB or explicitly selected
DuckLake; those are different storage backends with the same user workflow.
